quotes.title: WASP-166
quotes.card: WASP-166, also named Filetdor, is an F-type main-sequence star 373 light-years away in the constellation Hydra.
quotes.introduction: With an apparent magnitude of 9.4, it is too faint to be visible to the naked eye.
